mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.deleted = 0 AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_sort ASC, r.id ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND status = 1 AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE
